claim: The official public portal bundle contains the OAuth user-guide body. It describes user consent and account selection, authorization-code grants, and refreshing an access token with a refresh token.
impact_on_spec: Separate owner consent/account entitlement from routine access-token renewal.
limitations: Generic portal/LOB guidance, not the Individual Trader API account contract, exact token lifetime or paper sandbox proof.

claim: Official guidance says user revocation, account-credential or two-factor changes, changed scopes/accounts, or some security-policy changes can require restarting consent; routine access-token expiration can use refresh.
impact_on_spec: Unattended execution cannot assume irrevocable or perpetual access. Do not bypass owner revocation or treat an expired/revoked authorization as a transient order failure.
limitations: Generic portal guidance, no owner token/account operations inspected. Numerical expiry periods and exact Individual Trader product contract remain unverified.
